BAGHEL - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE AND RESPONDENT NO.2 BY SHIR RAKESH PANDEY - ADVOCATE) This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following: ORDER This application under Article 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking following relief(s):- "(i) That. this Hon'ble court may kindly be pleased to exercise inherent powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and quash criminal proceedings in relation to F.I.R. dt. 24.8.21 (Annexure A/1) in connection with Crime No.04/21 registered by Police Station Mahila Thana, Narsinghpur, District Narsinghpur (M.P.). in the interest of justice. (ii) That, this Hon'ble court may kindly be pleased to call for the case diary in relation to Crime no.04/21". 2. The applicant No.1 is the father-in-law, applicant No.2 is the mother-in-law and applicant No.3 is the Sister-in-law and applicant No.4 is the husband. 3. The prosecution story in short is that the respondent No.2 lodged a FIR alleging that she got married to the applicant No.4 on 01.11.2007 and is blessed with two children aged about 13 and 8 years.
texts.facts: For about one and half months after her marriage, she was kept properly by her in laws. Thereafter, from 15.03.2019 her husband Ashfaq Ahamad, father-in-law Iqbal Ahmed, mother-in-law Shahnaz Ahamad and sister-in-law Nazia Khan started harassing her on household works. They used to turn her out of her matrimonial house. They were compelling the respondent No.2 to remain hungry for days together and they were also assaulting and abusing her filthily. Even her father-in-law mother-in-law used to oust her from her matrimonial house after abusing her Smt. Shahnaz Ahmed vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96852519/ 2 filthily, however she was somehow managing their affairs. Later on, she narrated the incident to her mother Shaheen Sultana and brother Gayas. However, they used to sent her back to her matrimonial house after persuading her. Whenever, she demanded money from husband or father-in-law for payment of fees of children then instead of giving money they used to insult her by using filthy language even in presence of others and thus they were harassing her physically and mentally. In the month of October, 2020 her husband took her and her children to Gadarwara where again he continued to assault her by using filthy language. On 16.07.2021, her father-in-law, mother-in-law and sister-in-law were going to Bhopal and on the issue of providing food to them, her husband, mother-in-law and sister-in- law abused her and she was turned out of her matrimonial house. Thereafter, she informed her brother Gayas who brought them to Kareli. She informed the incident to her mother, brother, uncle but since she was not interested in spoiling her family life, therefore she did not file FIR at the earliest. 4. Challenging the FIR, it is submitted by counsel for applicants that the applicants No.1 and 2 are old and infirm person aged about 64 years and 71 years respectively. They belong to a reputed family. They do not have any criminal antecedents. In fact the respondent No.2 is a greedy lady and in collusion with her brother she has lodged false report. Even, her brother is a notorious person of the locality. The applicant No.2 is an Advocate and applicant No.1 is his wife. They are residing separately from the daughter-in-law. Nazia Khan, applicant No.3 is married woman. She got married to Shri Ayazuddin Khan in the year 2003 and since then she is living along with her husband. The applicant No.3 is blessed with two children aged about 16 years and 12 years. Her matrimonial house is situated at a distance of approximately 200 KM away from the matrimonial house of the complainant. The applicant No.3 herself is prosecuting studies in Bhopal. The applicant No.4 is the owner and proprietor of an industry namely M/s A-1 Super Pipe Industries situated in Narsinghpur. After the industry was opened in the year 2016, the behavior of the complainant completely changed towards the applicants. She became habitual of waking up at 12:00 AM and watching T.V. till 1:00 to 2:00 AM in the night. She was in habit of talking on mobile phone till late night. She has no time to spend with her own minor kids and her husband. The applicants never made any demand of dowry and the applicants belong to Muslim community and dowry system is not prevailing in that community. The FIR was lodged without conducting a preliminary enquiry. The allegation that the applicants picked up a quarrel while they were going to Bhopal is concern, the same is an imaginary allegation and complainant has tried to take advantage of the fact that the applicant No. 1 and 2 had gone to Bhopal. In fact, the applicants No.1 and 2 had no breathing time to take halt at Gadarwara even for a minute. The allegation of not providing money for payment of school fee is false because even the applicant No.4 has set up an industry in Narsinghpur on his own. It is further submitted that the allegations made against the applicants are vague, general and omnibus in nature and, therefore, they are liable to be [LEAKAGE_MASK]. Even before the investigation is completed by the investigating agency, the High Court entertained the writ petition, and by virtue of interim order granted by the High Court, further investigation was stalled.

In our opinion, such extra ordinary delay in lodging the FIR raises grave doubt about the truthfulness of allegations made by respondent 2 against appellants 1, 2 and 3, which are, in any case, general in nature.

We are of the confirmed opinion that continuation of the criminal proceedings against appellants 1, 2 and 3 pursuant to this FIR is an abuse of process of law.
